title: AgentSettings
description: What an AI seat runs as, on the wire between the lobby (which chooses it, in the seat assignment) and the wrapper/driver (which read it). One spelling: camelCase. This is NOT the shape of AgentSettings.env() - the claude CLI reads MODEL/EFFORT/MAX_THINKING_TOKENS as environment variables, a separate wire this schema does not describe, and it is NOT the browser-facing shape decks_api.py accepts when a game is created, which stays snake_case for the UI.

maxThinkingTokens.description: MAX_THINKING_TOKENS, or null for no explicit budget.
